doctrine: LA Photography Operating Manual: 5-lane market structure (Founder Personal Branding: $3k-$20k, recurring; Creator Content Retainer: volume monthly; Talent Portfolio: gateway market; Brand/E-Com Campaign: $8k-$60k revenue-driven; Editorial/Art: status play). Core mechanics: photography only wins when plugged into money flow + distribution + status. Founder Imaging tier system (Reset $1.5k-$3k, Operator Kit $4k-$8k, Brand System $10k-$20k+). Lead acquisition: LinkedIn primary, founder targeting (active posting, visual inconsistency gap, Series A-C or $500k-$5M). Value proposition shift from 'shoot' to '12-month visual system for 6-12 month utility.' DM formula: observation-curiosity-conversation, never pitch. Cold email + Instantly toolchain for scaling. Sales script structure: diagnose usage → expose gap → install system → anchor price to outcome. 90-day revenue target: $10k-$20k/month (3-5 clients at $3k-$5k, scaling to $50k requires leverage stacking: raise pricing, add retainers, reduce client count, introduce high-ticket projects). Outsourcing SOPs: lead sourcing, outreach DMs, engagement, CRM, delivery (assistant handles repeatable; founder keeps: calls, closes, creative, relationships). Assistant structure: $5-$8/hr base + $10-20 per booked call + $50-100 per close (performance alignment). Team scaling: Phase 1 one person dial quality, Phase 2 2-3 people same SOP, Phase 3 scale volume. Weekly KPI dashboard: DMs sent, replies, calls booked, calls held, deals closed, revenue. Reactivation path: reset expectations, structure SOP, start sourcing-only, add outreach after quality approval. Content strategy: LinkedIn posts as authority layer (problem exposure, breakdown, contrarian take) driving 60% inbound by month 3. Offer lock: one problem (visual inconsistency), one outcome (usable imagery), one mechanism (structured shoot). Layer 1 = sell simple, Layer 2 = execute creatively.
gates: never pitch in DM; observe then ask
quality-first over volume; slow hiring until system dialed
one lane focus; founder imaging or brand/ecom, not mixed
offer lock; no feature creep until $20k/month stable
no free unless high-leverage founder with distribution + network
price raises only after 10+ real conversations and clear demand signal
track weekly KPIs; weakest link identifies constraint
workflows: Founder discovery: LinkedIn search (Founder Los Angeles) + 20-second profile audit + visual inconsistency pattern match
DM sequence: engage post (like/comment) -> observation opener -> curiosity follow-up (48hr) -> soft transition to system -> low-friction call book
Call structure: open (context) -> discovery (usage audit) -> gap (reframe problem as system) -> solution (one structured shoot) -> price (anchor to outcome) -> close (low pressure)

First shoot design: 4 context captures (authority, approachability, working/context, casual/social) + pre-shoot diagnosis + during-shoot reinforcement + delivery (organized folders) + post-delivery usage trigger
Referral extraction: delivery -> usage follow-up -> referral ask (who in your circle building presence) -> trust transfer loop
90-day plan: Phase 1 (Days 1-30) get 2-3 clients + proof, Phase 2 (Days 31-60) stabilize 1 client/week + pricing raise, Phase 3 (Days 61-90) hit $10k-$20k/month + retainer intro
Day 1-7 execution: setup LinkedIn -> post signal -> send DMs -> follow up -> push conversations -> attempt close
Content loop: shoot founder -> extract insight -> post breakdown -> attract similar founders -> repeat
Assistant handoff: message reset expectations -> Day 1 sourcing calibration -> Day 2 outreach with approval -> Day 3+ scale if quality holds
Reinvest cash flow: new client acquisition (2 at $10k) + retainers (5 at $3k/month = $15k) + 1-2 campaign projects ($10k-$15k) = $45k-$50k stack
prompts: Founder outreach DM observation: 'Hey quick note. Saw your LinkedIn and recent posts. Strong momentum. Your visuals are doing two slightly different things though [specific gap]. Not pitching anything, just something I notice a lot with founders.'
Warm follow-up DM: 'Curious are you actively using your current photos or just kind of piecing things together?'
Post positioning shift: 'I build the visual infrastructure for founder-led brands' not 'I shoot founders'

LinkedIn post template (problem exposure): 'Most founders don't have a content problem. They have a visual inconsistency problem. [specific examples]. That disconnect costs credibility. One structured shoot fixes that for 6-12 months.'

Call open: 'I've been working with founders on structuring their imagery so it actually works across everything they're doing. Before I explain anything, I'm curious how you're currently handling that.'
Call discovery: 'Where do your images actually show up right now? [pause]. What are you currently using for those? [pause]. Does it feel consistent or kind of pieced together?'
Call gap: 'Yeah that's pretty common. Most founders don't have a content problem, it's just not structured.'
Call solution: 'What I do is fix that in one structured shoot. We capture everything you need across contexts so you're covered for the next 6-12 months.'
Call price (no hesitation): 'Most founders I work with invest between 4-8k for this depending on scope. [stop talking]'

Price objection reframe (too expensive): 'For the founders who do it, it's usually because they're already showing up a lot and the inconsistency is costing them. If that's not happening yet, it makes sense to wait.'
Delivery message: 'This should cover you across platforms for the next 6-12 months.'
Post-delivery follow-up: 'Glad those landed. Curious where you're planning to use them first?'
Referral trigger: 'If this was useful, I'm running a few more of these for founders right now. Anyone in your circle building their presence who could benefit?'
Retainer intro: 'Most people refresh this every 3-6 months. As things evolve, we update the visuals. Something we can plan ahead if it makes sense.'

Assistant onboarding message: 'We're building a system that connects with founders on LinkedIn and turns conversations into booked calls. Your role is NOT to sell. Your role is: find the right people, start conversations, keep everything organized. Everything follows a specific structure. No improvising for now, just execute cleanly.'
tools: Instantly (warm email sequences, 5 emails pre-warmed for scaling)
Google Sheets or Airtable (CRM: name, LinkedIn URL, status, last contact, visual gap, notes, deal value, close date)
Calendar booking tool (define calls, send links, confirm 24hr prior)
Higgsfield or Runway (optional: post-delivery creative enhancement; not core to offer messaging)
Email sequences (follow-up automation after initial DM reply)
operating_rules: Geographic focus: LA-based or frequent presence mandatory for shoot logistics + network density
Founder profile (ideal early targets): Seed-Series B or $500k-$5M revenue, public-facing (LinkedIn weekly, podcasts, speaking), visual inconsistency visible, SaaS/agency/DTC/creator-hybrid industries
DM response target: 10-15 replies per week from 25-40 DMs sent (quality targeting over volume)
Call conversion: 3-5 calls per week from replies, 20-30% close rate early stage (1 close per 4-5 calls)
Revenue: Phase 1 $2k-$6k/month, Phase 2 $6k-$12k, Phase 3-4 $12k-$20k, Phase 5+ $20k-$30k
Outreach cadence: 5-8 DMs/day, 2-3 LinkedIn posts per week (problem, breakdown, contrarian), 5-10 comment engagements daily
Pricing principle: charge for utility duration (6-12 month asset life) and placement scope (LinkedIn, press, social, site), not hours
Tier pricing: Starter $2k-$3k (entry), Core $5k-$8k (most founders), System $10k-$15k+ (high leverage); raise after 10+ conversations
First 3 clients: 1 free (high-leverage only if meets distribution/network/brand filters), 2 discounted ($500-$1k); no free tier as strategy
Retainer structure: quarterly refresh at $3k-$5k, adds baseline $10k-$15k/month recurring after 5+ clients
Portfolio: 10-20 images max, multi-context sets (1 founder to 4 use cases), before/after if possible, zero events/weddings/random creative
Shoot delivery: organized into folders (LinkedIn, Press, Speaking, Casual), usage guidance provided, light text direction, 6-12 month coverage framing
Referral ask timing: 2-3 days post-delivery after usage confirmation; expect 1-3 referrals per client
Content posting: 2-3 per week, problem exposure (best performing), breakdown, contrarian take format; no generic 'great shoot today' posts
Assistant performance metric: base pay aligns with market ($5-8/hr), performance bonus ($10-20 per booked call, $50-100 per closed deal) shifts from task to outcome
QA before delegation: review messaging, leads, CRM accuracy daily in first 7 days; only scale volume after quality locked
No mixtures: one lane (founder imaging or brand work), no weddings/events/random, no feature creep on offer (simple sell, creative delivery)
Weekly review: 15 minutes max, check DMs sent/replies/calls booked/calls held/revenue, identify ONE constraint, give one instruction
Raise pricing trigger: people say yes fast, little hesitation, fast closes = underpriced
Fix conversion trigger: interested but hesitate (sounds cool, let me think, no urgency) = weak positioning, not weak offer
content_ideas: Problem exposure series: visual inconsistency patterns (LinkedIn vs press vs site), outdated headshots costing credibility, founders using random iPhone + pro mixes
Breakdown posts: before/after system design, show how one shoot captures 4 contexts (authority, approachable, working, casual), position 'system' vs 'photoshoot' language
Contrarian takes: headshots outdated (incomplete), founders need library not one photo, visual consistency as business problem not creative problem
Case study format: founder story -> problem diagnosis -> solution (structured shoot) -> outcome (where visuals now show up), testimonial embedded
Weekly insights: 'Most founders don't have [problem]. They have [system problem]' template, repeated variations for LA founder personas
Content loop automation: shoot deliverable -> extract breakdown -> post within week -> tag similar founder audience -> expect DM replies
Founder mythology: founder as operator framing, not artist, visual consistency = professional signal, perception = leverage mechanic
Objection carousel: 'Already have photos' reframe, 'Not a priority' urgency flip, 'Too expensive' outcome anchoring, 'Let me think' clarification
System design posts: tier positioning (reset/operator kit/brand system), pricing rationale (outcome duration), why one shoot works
Distribution piece: Gary Vee $1.80 Instagram strategy adapted to LinkedIn founder discovery (comment engagement before DM), hashtag research equivalent (founder titles + Los Angeles search)

weird_gold: The $1.80 Instagram strategy (Gary Vee) applied: .02 cents on top 9 posts per 10 hashtags = $1.80 daily value. Directly parallelizable to LinkedIn founder targeting: engagement on top posts in 'Founder Los Angeles' searches.
Founder scoring system (1-5 scale): Distribution + Network Density + Brand Awareness, total <10 = don't do free. Operationalizes when to invest leverage.

Weakest link constraint theory: revenue breaks where system is weakest, not on overall effort. Weekly KPI dashboard identifies constraint directly (low DMs, low replies, low calls, low closes each indicates different fix).
Layer separation insight: Layer 1 (offer sell) stays simple, Layer 2 (execution) gets creative freedom. Lets user explore AI/compositing/creative depth without breaking sales positioning.

The referral trust transfer mechanic: Client trusts your work -> client introduces you to 2-3 similar people -> those people inherit trust without you 'pitching.' Network compounds via inherited credibility.

Pre-stage assistant: reactivate existing contractor with structured SOPs vs hiring new. Cheaper on-ramp, built context, scales team (his team). Payment structure shift incentivizes outcomes not task completion.
Retainer momentum: quarterly $3k/founder + 5 founders = $15k recurring floor, unlocks $50k architecture without adding 10x client count.
Visual gap pattern matching: outdated headshot + random iPhone posts + no style = founder in motion who needs the system. 20-second profile scan predicts demand signal.
